title: Commission accepts commitments by Sanofi to address possible anticompetitive disparagement of competing flu vaccine for vulnerable patients
content: European Commission Press release Brussels, 14 Oct 2026 The European Commission has made commitments offered by Sanofi legally binding under EU antitrust rules. The commitments relate to the Commission's preliminary competition concerns relating to Sanofi's alleged disparagement campaigns in Germany and France against Fluad, the only enhanced flu vaccine for vulnerable patients that competes with Sanofi's Efluelda.
